leadText:
The Delicious Day with Pokémon (Simplified Chinese: Pokémon Came to My House, Japanese: The Delicious Day with Pokémon), also known as Pokémon and Cat's Kitchen (Simplified Chinese: Pokémon × ), is a series of short videos featuring Sean Jiang, also known as Lao Dao, and his life with Pokémon. It was produced as a collaboration between The Pokémon Company, Pokémon Shanghai, and the Chinese video creator team Cat's Kitchen (also known as Sean's Kitchen; Simplified Chinese: Rishiji, Japanese: Nisshokuki).

It consists of two seasons with three episodes each: Pokémon Sweets Paradise (Simplified Chinese: and Pokémon Series, Japanese: Sweet Winter with Pokémon), which was released on the Cat's Kitchen Bilibili, Weibo, and YouTube channel in Chinese from February 7 to 14, 2022, on the official Japanese Pokémon YouTube channel from February 15 to 22, 2022, and on the English Pokémon Kids TV YouTube channel from March 14 to May 13, 2022; and Camping Trip with Pokémon (Simplified Chinese: Pokémon at Home, Japanese: Camping Trip with Pokémon), which was released on the Cat's Kitchen Bilibili, Weibo, and YouTube channel in Chinese and on the official Japanese Pokémon YouTube channel from October 9 to 17, 2023, and on the English Pokémon Kids TV YouTube channel, Instagram, and Facebook from December 5 to 19, 2023.

As a tie-in to the animated shorts, a set of animated stickers and s based on the Pokémon seen in the shorts was released on LINE on April 30, 2024, on on June 8, 2024, and on on December 13, 2024.
